title: The Parasite That Controls Your Mind to Make You Braver
hook: A common parasite in cat feces can make you less fearful of danger, even causing risky behavior in humans.
why_this_can_go_viral: Challenges free will narrative; viewers will wonder if a parasite is controlling their own choices.

title: The Statistic That 1 in 5 Plane Crashes Is Caused by Your Own Body
hook: Pilot dehydration causes cognitive failure so severe that it accounts for 20% of aviation accidents — more than bird strikes.
why_this_can_go_viral: Flying anxiety meets shocking stat; people love to learn mundane things that cause catastrophic failure.

title: The Physics That Makes Ice Cream Burn Your Throat
hook: Eating ice cream too fast triggers a violent spasm in your vagus nerve, mimicking a heart attack.
why_this_can_go_viral: Relatable experience with a terrifying twist — everyone has had brain freeze but doesn't know it can mimic a cardiac event.

title: The Physics That Makes Your Voice Shatter a Glass — and Your Eardrum
hook: At exactly 100 decibels at the right frequency, a human scream can rupture your own eardrum and break glass simultaneously.
why_this_can_go_viral: Cool science meets visceral danger — people love demonstrations of voice power.

title: The Everyday Danger of Your Sunglasses Betraying Your Eyes
hook: Cheap sunglasses without UV protection dilate your pupils, letting in more harmful radiation than wearing none at all.
why_this_can_go_viral: Counterintuitive warning that almost everyone needs to hear — perfect for shareable public service content.

title: The Parasite That Turns Snails into Zombie Eyestalks
hook: A fluke worm invades a snail's eyestalks, pulsates to attract birds, and gets eaten to complete its life cycle.
why_this_can_go_viral: Gross, visually unforgettable, and utterly alien — perfect for shock-and-share loops.

title: The Physics That Makes a Bulletproof Vest Kill You Slowly
hook: Bulletproof vests stop the bullet but transfer the kinetic energy into your chest, causing fatal internal bleeding hours later.
why_this_can_go_viral: Counterintuitive and terrifying — safety gear that secretly kills you. High threat perception.

title: The Nature Paradox of the Fungus That Glows at Night to Attract Prey
hook: Bioluminescent fungi in caves use eerie green light to lure insects into sticky threads, then digest them alive.
why_this_can_go_viral: Beautiful and horrifying — perfect 'nature is metal' content with stunning visuals.

title: The Cognitive Reality Gap That You Are Blind for 40 Minutes a Day
hook: Every time you blink, your brain edits out the blackness — but micro-blackouts during blinks add up to 40 minutes of blindness you never notice.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mind-blowing everyday illusion that challenges perception of reality — highly shareable.

title: The Geographic Horror Where the Sea Foam Burns Your Skin
hook: During algal blooms on South African beaches, sea foam concentrates neurotoxins that can cause burns, blindness, and seizures.
why_this_can_go_viral: Beautiful looking foam hides a deadly secret — perfect for 'don't trust nature' content.

title: The Animal That Has 32 Brains and Survives Being Chopped in Half
hook: Leeches have 32 ganglia that act like independent brains — cut one in half and both halves can move and feed separately.
why_this_can_go_viral: Gross and superhuman ability — viewers love incredulous animal abilities.

title: The Statistical Illusion That Your Cat Is More Likely to Kill You Than a Wolf
hook: Cat scratch disease kills more people annually in the US than wolf attacks worldwide — and it can trigger psychosis.
why_this_can_go_viral: Shocking comparison between a cuddly pet and a predator — perfect for dark humor shares.

title: The Everyday Danger of Your Eyeglasses Focusing Sunlight to Burn Your Retina
hook: Convex lenses in glasses can concentrate sunlight like a magnifying glass, causing permanent retinal burns on sunny days.
why_this_can_go_viral: Surprising everyday risk — everyone with glasses will pause and check.

title: The Physics That Makes a Hummingbird's Heart Stop Mid-Flight
hook: A hummingbird's heart beats 1,260 times per minute — but it can suddenly stop to enter torpor, and the bird falls like a stone.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme biology meets physics — beautiful creature with a terrifying survival trick.

title: The Nature Paradox of the Plant That Drives Pollinators to Dehydration Death
hook: The pitcher plant's nectar intoxicates insects with alcohol, causing them to lose balance, fall in, and drown in digestive fluid.
why_this_can_go_viral: Twist on classic plant horror — the bug gets drunk first, then drowned. Darkly comedic.

title: The Cognitive Reality Gap That You Forgot 90% of Your Life
hook: Childhood amnesia erases nearly all memories before age 3 — you've already forgotten 90% of your personal history.
why_this_can_go_viral: Deeply unsettling existential fact that applies to everyone — triggers reflection and sharing.

title: The Geographic Horror Where the Air Itself Peels Skin Off Your Body
hook: In the Dasht-e Lut desert of Iran, ground temperatures hit 80°C — hot enough to cook eggs and cause third-degree burns from just breathing.
why_this_can_go_viral: Sci-fi level horror that is real — air that cooks you alive. Visceral and shareable.
